# R5.16 — Finite-manifest Bayesian efficacy (leg a: eval/ontology method contract)

Implements contract `docs/tickets/185_R5.16__beta.md` (seq 185), as rescoped by the `aa196851` **SPLIT ruling at the Packet D D.2 owner map — boundary as proposed**. This leg carries the method contract; the analysis/embed routing re-lands at seq 185a (`185a_R5.16b__beta-routing.md`). Offline-only; USD 0; merges OPERATOR.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-eval/src/finite_manifest.rs` (new, ~838 lines) — the admitted `finite_manifest_contrast` estimator over the R5.15 `PlannedPopulation` (consumed unchanged; `contrib` → `pub(crate)`, one counting rule): independent per-cell `Beta(c+1, n−c+1)` posteriors, `Δ^(b) = Σ_t w_t [p_Bt − p_At]` (`w_t=1/T`), i64-ppm inverse-CDF draws by bisection on `regularized_beta` under canonical-input-seeded `XorShift64`, declared 8,000-draw interval with the frozen doubling record at 16/32/64k (`numerical_error` a fact), analytic posterior mean, observed equal-task contrast, labelled 95% equal-tail **credible** interval, `beta{2,2}` predeclared-exploratory sensitivity, `ContrastError` closed refusal set (one task, missing/short/unresolved cells, dependence, pooled/hierarchical substitute, unknown method, unsupported prior/level, nonfinite, metadata-only, credible-as-TOST, unannotated multi-strata), S.1 `MethodMetadata` + Packet D.3 payload members.
- `crates/hh-ontology/src/eval.rs` — `IntervalMethod::FiniteManifestContrast(prior)` dialect-bump member (owning codec — no generated-schema change).
- `crates/hh-eval/src/scorecard.rs` — the member is contrast-level, never a per-cell interval: `n/a{estimator_undefined}` at cell scope (metadata-only support fails).
- `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_16.rs` — the estimator battery (fails-without: the module does not exist at base).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0395` — landing decisions + the pre-ruled size deviation record; index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BL-47 sources home.
- `docs/build/runs/R5.16.md` — run ledger (gate verbatim, guard reads, evidence, STOP/ruling record).
